en: A sepia-toned image showing a quiet street scene. The street is lined with large trees and substantial wooden buildings with many windows, typical of late 19th or early 20th-century Northern European architecture. There is a picket fence along one property and utility poles along the street. A few people, possibly children, can be seen walking on the sidewalk. The text 'Storgaten, Villa Edel' appears in the bottom left corner.
